skill.name: makepad-skills
skill.description: Makepad UI development skills for Rust apps: setup, patterns, shaders, packaging, and troubleshooting.
skill.summary: Guides Makepad UI setup, patterns, shaders, packaging, and troubleshooting for Rust apps.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The two static findings are hardcoded GitHub URLs in metadata and documentation, not runtime network behavior. No prompt injection, executable code, or data exfiltration intent was found in SKILL.md.

finding_verdicts.reason: The URL appears in front matter as a source repository reference. It does not instruct the agent to fetch data or transmit information.
The URL is a documentation link to the source repository. SKILL.md contains no executable code, network request logic, or data sharing instruction.

content.value_statement: Rust developers need focused guidance when building Makepad user interfaces. This skill provides setup, UI pattern, shader, packaging, and troubleshooting help.
actual_capabilities: Guides setup for Makepad UI projects in Rust apps.
Supports guidance for Makepad shader work.
Covers packaging considerations for Makepad apps.
Helps troubleshoot Makepad UI development issues.
limitations: Provides guidance only and includes no executable scripts.
Does not include sample project files beyond SKILL.md.
Does not replace testing on target platforms.
Does not verify external repository content during use.

use_cases.title: Start a Makepad UI Project
use_cases.description: Plan setup steps and project structure for a new Rust app that uses Makepad.

use_cases.title: Improve Interface Patterns
use_cases.description: Review Makepad UI patterns before adding screens, controls, or layout behavior.

use_cases.title: Resolve Makepad Build Issues
use_cases.description: Diagnose packaging, shader, or UI problems with focused Makepad troubleshooting guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Project Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan the setup for a new Rust app that uses Makepad for its user interface.

prompt_templates.title: Choose UI Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Suggest Makepad UI patterns for a Rust app with several screens, reusable controls, and responsive layout needs.

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot Shader Behavior
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me diagnose a Makepad shader issue. Ask for the relevant symptoms, target platform, and recent changes.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Packaging Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Makepad Rust app release plan and identify packaging risks, platform checks, and troubleshooting steps.

output_examples.input: I need to start a Makepad UI for a Rust app.
output_examples.output: A concise setup plan with project prerequisites, Makepad integration steps, and early validation checks.

output_examples.input: My Makepad interface has shader and packaging issues.
output: A symptom checklist for shader behavior.
A packaging review path for target platforms.

best_practices: Share target platforms and Makepad version context before asking for packaging help.
Describe visible UI symptoms clearly when requesting shader troubleshooting.
Use the guidance as a checklist and verify changes with local builds.
anti_patterns: Do not assume the skill can execute or test Makepad projects.
Do not request broad Rust architecture advice without Makepad context.
Do not rely on external repository links as verified security evidence.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps with Makepad UI setup, patterns, shaders, packaging, and troubleshooting for Rust apps.

faq.question: Does it run Makepad commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides guidance only and includes no executable scripts.

faq.question: Can it help with shaders?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide shader troubleshooting and planning for Makepad interfaces.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is this a complete Makepad tutorial?
faq.answer: No. It is a focused guidance skill based on a short SKILL.md file.

faq.question: What should I provide in prompts?
faq.answer: Provide your Makepad goal, Rust app context, target platform, and the issue you want to solve.
